# LAIZA™

> LAIZA™ is an Indian online brand of men's leather wallets, card holders and keychains in genuine and Italian leather. It is a brand of Laiza International, Sagara, Karnataka, India, run by Proprietor Jainul Abhid. Official website: https://laizalifestyle.com

## Key facts
- Brand: LAIZA™ (also written LAIZA; website name Laiza Lifestyle). Tagline: "Define Your Presence".
- Business: Laiza International, Sagara, Karnataka, India. Proprietor: Jainul Abhid.
- Sells online across India at https://laizalifestyle.com
- Materials: genuine leather, Italian leather and genuine hunter leather (real leather, not PU).
- RFID blocking: only the two pop-up card wallets (Grey and Tan).
- Gift box: every LAIZA™ wallet (LW-001 to LW-006) comes in a black LAIZA™ gift box. Card holders and keychains come in standard packing.
- Delivery: free delivery across India. Usually dispatched in 1–2 business days, delivered in 5–7 business days.
- Payment: Cash on Delivery available; UPI / cards via PayU. ₹100 off on online payment for orders of ₹699 and above.
- Returns: 7-day returns.
- Contact: hello@laizalifestyle.com · WhatsApp https://wa.me/919731674173
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/laiza_lifestyle
